question: All of the following are true about loop diuretics except:

options.opa: They are called as "high ceiling" diuretics
options.opd: Loop diuretics lead to hypercalcemia and hypomagnesimia

analysis: Loop diuretics are known to cause hypocalcemia and hypomagnesemia, not hypercalcemia. This is due to their mechanism of action in the loop of Henle in the kidney.
